facts.heading: WHERE IT BEGAN
facts.body: China led in 1800 with 330.0 million people of population - 33.8% of everything recorded that year.

facts.heading: THE RECORDED TOTAL
facts.body: Across the period the combined total went from 977.3 million to 8.06 billion people - about 8.2x.

facts.heading: BIGGEST SINGLE-YEAR JUMP
facts.body: The largest one-year rise in the pool is China in 1970, up 42.3 million people.

facts.heading: INDIA TAKES THE LEAD
facts.body: India overtook China in 2022 at 1.43 billion people.

facts.heading: FASTEST RISER
facts.body: Brazil multiplied its population by 84x over the period, reaching 211.1 million people.

facts.heading: WHERE IT STANDS
facts.body: India tops the 2023 table at 1.44 billion people, 17.8% of the recorded total.
